name: w3a_slot_thrash_sequential
description: Baseline for w3b. Three agents with different 500-token system prompts, each running ten short turns with growing history. `start_delay_s` staggers them so only one agent is active at a time: the second starts after the first has finished all its turns, and the third after the second. Within one agent's run the server reuses its own prompt cache; across agents it doesn't, but the switch cost is paid at most twice. With OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL >= 3 this looks like three w2a runs; with NUM_PARALLEL = 1 it still looks fine because the agents never actually interleave. The real thrash is in w3b.
